name: First Financial and Technical Development Center
legal_or_reported_name: First Financial and Technical Development Center

attribution.legal_posture: Treasury announced an October 28, 2026 administrative designation under E.O. 13722 for worker exportation, including revenue generation for the DPRK government or Workers’ Party of Korea. Treasury’s operational assessments remain distinct from the administrative action and are not criminal convictions.

identity_boundary: The First Financial and Technical Development Center explicitly named in the October 28, 2026 Treasury release and OFAC notice. The Treasury abbreviation FFTDC is used only for that named entity.
caveats: The Treasury release and companion OFAC notice form one source family; they are not independent corroboration.
Administrative designation is distinct from a criminal charge or conviction. Conduct statements are Treasury assessments, not adjudicated criminal findings.
Roles and activity periods are retained only as reported on October 28, 2026; no current employment, control or whereabouts are inferred.
